rules.name: BESTOW THE ENDURANCE OF BEDROCK
rules.text: When [Blight] is added to one of your lands, unless the [Blight] then outnumbers your [Presence] , it does not cascade or destroy [Presence] (yours or others').
rules.evidence: Ravage in l2 (1 Blight + 1 added vs 2 Stone Presence): bedrock-check l2 2 1, then no destroy-presence and no cascade from that add-blight, on seeds 7/1/2. A later Power-added 3rd Blight (outnumbers) destroys Presence and cascades normally.
rules.notes: Direct fit: two empty-RHS exceptions scoped to the add-blight episode, gated by values read at its start (Blight before + 1 vs Presence). Depends on core exposing destroy-presence and cascade as separate episodes inside add-blight. 'Then outnumbers' is computed as B+1 (arithmetic via #js-def plus).

rules.name: DEEP LAYERS EXPOSED TO THE SURFACE
rules.text: The first time you uncover each of your "+1 Card Play" [Presence] spaces, gain a Minor Power. (They're marked with [Minorsymbol] as a reminder.)
rules.turn:
gain-power S D, ^gained-power S D
#acc deep-layers-done : space
uncovered Sp / deep-layers-done Sp
move P To, at P Sp, space:owner Sp S, space:bonus Sp card-play
  spirit:special S deep-layers, not deep-layers-done Sp
  +uncovered Sp
  ~gain-power S minor
rules.evidence: s3 moved off the card-play space, back on, off again: one deep-layers-done sp-card 1 and one gained-power stone minor.
rules.notes: 'Uncover' = a move whose piece was on the space at the move's start (acc `at` read at the episode start gives the old location). 'The first time' needs a persistent #agg flag per space; with several turns an #agg flag is the right scope here (once per game). Presence-track spaces had to be modeled as locations (BASE-EXT). Port to fresh-left ^ / #acc (2026-10-12): the #agg bool "first time" flag became a boolean acc relation over an `uncovered` event, read with `not`; same outcome.

base_ext: Presence-track spaces as locations (space:owner, space:bonus); gain-power recorded only (no deck).
language_issues: Core runs Blight's two consequences (destroy Presence, cascade) as sibling episodes, so a cascade that returns to the same land sees Presence that its sibling already destroyed: p1 was 'destroyed' 5 times in one run; core should sequence them (`~>destroy-presence…; ~cascade`).
Core has no Blight supply, so once two adjacent lands are blighted the cascade can ping-pong indefinitely (bounded only by rng luck); real game ends by running out of Blight.
